name: pothole_v1
architecture: YOLO11s, single class "pothole", 1024 px, 640 px tiles for large frames
trained_on: dataset pothole_v2: UAPD, UAV-PDD2023, top-down drone set (GitHub), street photos (Roboflow, train only)

full_frame.note: 22 test-only 4K drone frames, 78 labelled potholes (step S1-23)

weaknesses: Lane markings, roadside grass and wide dark cracks are sometimes flagged
UAV-PDD2023's tiny speck labels are missed (mAP50 0.03)
Public datasets define "pothole" differently; own drone photos are the next step
